description_en: Retrieves the details of each directory quota in a file system
description_zh: 获取文件系统每个目录配额的详细信息
name: DescribeDirQuotas

parameters.help_en:
The absolute path of the directory in the file system.

If this parameter is left empty, all directories that have quotas configured in the file system are returned
parameters.help_zh:
目录在文件系统中的绝对路径。

此项为空时会返回文件系统中全部已设置了配额的目录
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en:
The number of directories on each page. Default value: 10.

Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
每个分页包含的目录个数。默认值为10。

取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Start value (default value): 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页页码。

起始值（默认值）：1
parameters.name: page_number

DirQuotaInfos.description_en: The collection of quota information for each directory
DirQuotaInfos.description_zh: 每个目录的配额信息集合

DirInode.description_en: The inode number of the directory

Path.description_en: The absolute path of the directory in the file system
Path.description_zh: 目录在文件系统中的绝对路径

Status.description_en: The statistical status of the directory. The value is Initializing during initialization and Normal when the status is normal
Status.description_zh:
目录的统计状态。
初始化时为Initializing；正常时为Normal

UserQuotaInfos.description_en: The collection of quota information for each user
UserQuotaInfos.description_zh: 每个用户的配额信息集合

FileCountLimit.description_en: The maximum number of files that the user can create in the directory
FileCountLimit.description_zh: 目录下用户的文件数目限制

FileCountReal.description_en: The actual number of files owned by the user in the directory
FileCountReal.description_zh: 目录下用户的实际文件数目

QuotaType.description_en: The quota type. Valid values: Accounting (statistical quota) and Enforcement (restrictive quota)
QuotaType.description_zh: 配额类型，包括统计型（Accounting）和限制型（Enforcement）

SizeLimit.description_en: The maximum total size of files that the user can store in the directory. Unit: GiB
SizeLimit.description_zh: 目录下用户的文件总容量限制，单位为GiB

SizeReal.description_en: The actual total size of files owned by the user in the directory. Unit: GiB
SizeReal.description_zh: 目录下用户的实际文件总容量，单位为GiB

SizeRealInByte.description_en: The actual total size of files owned by the user in the directory. Unit: bytes
SizeRealInByte.description_zh: 目录下用户的实际文件总容量，单位为 Byte

UserId.description_en: The UID or GID to be restricted, depending on the value of UserType
UserId.description_zh: 要限制的Uid或Gid，取决于UserType的值

UserType.description_en:
The type of the UserId. Valid values: Uid, Gid, and AllUsers.
If the value is Uid or Gid, UserId has a return value.
If the value is AllUsers, UserId is empty
UserType.description_zh:
指定UserId的类型，包括Uid、Gid、AllUsers三种。
当返回为Uid或Gid时，UserId会存在返回值。
当返回为AllUsers时，UserId返回为空

PageSize.description_en: The number of directories on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 每个分页包含的目录个数
